description: Read an email inbox and get the verification code, OTP, signup link, or magic link from it. Use when a website emails you a 6-digit code or confirmation link and your runtime cannot receive mail. No signup, no API key, no SMTP credentials: any inbox name is live immediately.

inbox_prefix.description: Local part of the address, e.g. "agent-worker-1" for agent-worker-1@relay.local. Any name works without prior registration.
